theorem pull_dr (h a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (index gap : ℕ → ℕ) (f : ℕ → Point → ℝ) :
    (operators h index a b hab).dr (pull gap f) =
      pull gap ((operators h (fun n => index n + gap n) a b hab).dr f)
